Core.description: Required object. Core build and runtime configuration.

CSSEntryFiles.description: Optional object. CSS entry points for critical and non-critical style bundles. Both fields are optional and independent.

Critical.description:
Optional string. Critical CSS entry file. Relative to RootDir.

Example: "frontend/src/styles/main.critical.css"

NonCritical.description:
Optional string. Non-critical CSS entry file. Relative to RootDir.

Example: "frontend/src/styles/main.css"

GlobalWatchExcludePatterns.description: Optional array. Glob patterns excluded from all watch event processing. Relative to RootDir. Directories are auto-expanded to include all descendants.

HealthcheckEndpoint.description:
Optional string. HTTP endpoint path used for app readiness polling after restart.

Default: "/"

Examples: "/" or "/healthz"

MainAppEntry.description:
Required string. Go application entry path. If a directory is given, main.go is assumed. Relative to RootDir.

Examples: "cmd/serve" or "cmd/serve/main.go"

PreventImplicitGoBuildPatterns.description: Optional array. Glob patterns for .go files that should not implicitly trigger Go recompilation. Relative to RootDir. Directories are auto-expanded to include all descendants.

PublicPathPrefix.description:
Optional string. URL prefix for public static assets. Normalized to have leading and trailing slashes.

Default: "/"

Examples: "/" or "/public/"

ServerOnlyMode.description: Optional boolean. When true, run in server-only mode. This takes precedence over any static asset or CSS configuration that may also be present.

StaticAssetDirs.description: Optional object. Source directories for static assets. Both fields are optional and independent.

Private.description:
Optional string. Source directory for private static assets. Relative to RootDir.

Example: "backend/assets"

Public.description:
Optional string. Source directory for public static assets. Relative to RootDir.

Example: "frontend/assets"

LifecycleHooks.description: Optional array. Lifecycle hooks that run shell commands at defined points in the build cycle.

Cmd.description: Required string. Shell command to execute when the hook fires.

DevOnly.description: Optional boolean. When true, this hook only runs in dev mode.

DownstreamEffect.description: Required string. What downstream action this hook's completion triggers.

FinishBy.description: Required string. Latest checkpoint by which the hook must have completed.

IncludeFrontendRebuildingOverlay.description: Optional boolean. When true, a rebuilding overlay is shown in the browser while this hook runs.

ProdOnly.description: Optional boolean. When true, this hook only runs in prod mode.

StartAt.description: Required string. Earliest checkpoint at which the hook may begin execution.

WatchExcludePatterns.description: Optional array. Glob patterns excluded from this hook's watch scope. Relative to RootDir. Directories are auto-expanded.

WatchIncludePatterns.description: Required array. Glob patterns that activate this hook when matched. Relative to RootDir. Directories are auto-expanded.

RootDir.description: Required string. Root directory for resolving all other paths. Relative to the config file directory.

Vite.description: Optional object. Vite dev server configuration. When present, JSPackageManagerBaseCmd is required.

DefaultPort.description:
Optional number. Preferred Vite dev server port.

Default: 5173

JSPackageManagerBaseCmd.description:
Required string. Base command used to run Vite.

Examples: "pnpm", "npx", "yarn", or "bunx"

JSPackageManagerCmdDir.description: Optional string. Directory where the JS package manager command should run. Relative to RootDir.

ViteConfigFile.description:
Optional string. Explicit Vite config file path. Relative to RootDir.

Example: "vite.config.ts"
